transcription.description: Enable transcription as needed. Install local engines and models separately.
transcription.note: “Local” means the computer running the backend. Checking does not download models or transcribe audio. Existing transcripts remain available.
transcription.loadError: Cannot check transcription availability. Make sure the backend is running and try again.
transcription.installHelp: Run in the project’s backend directory. To keep multiple extensions, include all --extra options in the same uv command.
transcription.prepareHelp: After installing the engine, prepare its models separately (downloads model files):
transcription.enableHelp: Set TRANSCRIPTION_LOCAL_ENABLED=1 in backend/.env. Restart the backend with the corresponding --extra option, then check again.
transcription.cloudHelp: Set ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY and TRANSCRIPTION_CLOUD_ENABLED=1. Restart with --extra cloud-transcription. This service uploads audio and may incur charges.

fallbacks.not_installed: This transcription extension is not installed.
fallbacks.model_missing: Local models need to be prepared.
fallbacks.runtime_error: Environment check failed. Check your installation and configuration, then retry.
fallbacks.unsupported: This transcription provider is not supported in the current environment.

reasons.official_ready: Reads subtitles from the feed when they are available for an episode.
reasons.engine_missing: The local transcription engine is not installed.
reasons.local_disabled: The engine is installed. Prepare the models, set TRANSCRIPTION_LOCAL_ENABLED=1, and restart the backend.
reasons.cloud_disabled: Cloud transcription is disabled. Enabling it uploads audio and incurs service charges.
reasons.cloud_missing: The cloud transcription extension is not installed.
reasons.cloud_ready: Cloud transcription is configured. The connection and key will be verified on submission.
reasons.unsupported: This transcription method is not supported yet.
reasons.diarization_token_missing: Speaker identification is enabled, but a Hugging Face token with model access is missing.
reasons.device_unsupported: This engine supports CPU or NVIDIA CUDA. Update WHISPER_DEVICE.
reasons.compute_unsupported: The device does not support the selected precision. Check WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE.
reasons.model_missing: The configured local model was not found. Run the model preparation command first.
reasons.model_incomplete: Model files are incomplete. Prepare the model again.
reasons.vad_model_missing: The Silero voice detection model for WhisperX is not prepared.
reasons.vad_unsupported: The configured WhisperX voice detection method is not supported.
reasons.diarization_model_missing: Speaker identification models are missing. Configure Hugging Face access and prepare the models, or disable WHISPERX_DIARIZE.
reasons.local_ready: Runtime, device, and local model checks passed.
reasons.runtime_error: Runtime or device check failed. Check package versions and configuration.
reasons.probe_failed: Environment check failed or timed out. Check the environment and try again.

app.description: App behavior and task panel preferences are saved in this browser.
app.autoRefreshDescription: Refresh feeds and episode status on a schedule so downloads, transcriptions, and summaries stay in sync.
app.taskPollDescription: Controls how often the bottom-right task dial and task center check progress. Smaller values feel more live; larger values use fewer resources.
app.taskHistoryDescription: The backend keeps task records for up to 7 days; this controls how much completed and failed history the task center shows by default.
app.taskPanelDefaultOpenDescription: The bottom-right task dial is always visible. Enable this to expand the task center when you enter the app.
app.taskPanelDefaultOpenLabel: Expand task center when entering the app
